Field Description / Notes: A unique CECP reference number generated by Eudamed. The number will consists of: [NB ID + current_year + XXXX]

Field Label: Application ID for the conformity assessment
Field Description / Notes:
The reference number identifying the application for conformity assessment  the MF submitted to the NB. The CECP is for device(s) assessed in the context of this conformity assessment. 
Note: In case the MF withdraws the application for conformity assessment or the NB refuses the certificate, the NB will register a withdrawn application for conformity assessment (see sheet 'Application') or a refused certificate (see sheet 'Application') with the same reference number.
Defines the enumeration whether  CECP is for device type class III (Implantable) or class IIb (Active devices intended to administer and/or remove a medicinal product).

Field Label: Prior Consultation of Expert Panel by the Manufacturer
Field Description / Notes: When set to TRUE it indicates that the MF has consulted an Expert Panel as regards the clinical evaluation of the device, before the clinical evaluation consultation procedure.
The NB Identification number (assigned by NANDO) of the NB carrying out the conformity assessment of the device in the CECP.
The SRN of the MF of the device in the clinical evaluation (CECP).  The MF is identified by its SRN (a unique identification number assigned to the MF when it is registered as an Actor in Eudamed).

The SRN of the AR of the device in the clinical evaluation (CECP). It applies only when the MF of the device is a non-EU MF. The AR is identified by its SRN (a unique identification number assigned to the AR when it is registered as an Actor in Eudamed).
Indicates current status of a CECP.
Indicates all historical statuses of an CECP.

Indicates (enumeration) the workflow status of the CECP (for example if the clinical evaluation consultation procedure applies, if the CECP has been assigned to an Expert Panel, etc.).

Note: This information is additional internal Eudamed information for each CECP. A CECP has only one version i.e. the versionNumber in entity VersionData is always 1.
Indicates the date when the last status update has occurred.

Field Label: Reason for not following the CECP
Field Description / Notes: The reason (enumeration) for the non-following of the consultation procedure (scrutiny) to a CECP.

Complementary information (free text) in case the consultation procedure (scrutiny) does not apply or is not followed. It is optional for the NB to provide complementary information.
Refer also to fields cecpStatus and CECPNotFollowedReason.

Keeps information about the state of a CECP.

Note: This information is additional internal Eudamed information for each CECP. A CECP has only one version i.e. the versionNumber in entity VersionData is always 1.

The NB's clinical evaluation Assessment Report for the device in the CECP. It is language independent.
Refer also to fields of entity StoredDocument in sheet 'Common'.

Field Label: Is this Clinical Evaluation consultation procedure followed?
Field Description / Notes: When set to TRUE it indicates that the CECP is followed
Keeps information about the linked refused certificate or withdrawn application.
